decision_cruda.rationale: Radio at 10:00: C512-12 is stopped for ventilation and LH-04 is free. The CMMS file is empty, so radio and CMMS do not conflict and no confirmation is needed. Under RESERVE-01 a freed loader can activate a reserve, so I use LH-04. Haulage capacity (cycle time x 40 t payload x 0.227 factor): Central ~86 t/h (4 trucks, cycle ~0.42 h), Norte ~63 t/h, Este ~73 t/h. Norte is truck-limited (three LH514 give ~107 t/h), so it gets no loan. Central over the 6.5 loading hours: truck capacity ~559 t. Supply is 147 t stockpile + 144 t left at C512-01 (LH-06 runs out) + 179 t from C538-07 (LH-07 at 27.5 t/h), about 470 t. That leaves ~89 t of truck capacity unused. RS-C564-02 (8.9 g/t, 278 t broken, 160 m from stockpile) lets an LH514 muck ~38.5 t/h. Moving from level 512 takes ~0.33 h and activation 0.5 h, so ~5.7 h of mucking is available. The binding limit is the spare truck capacity of ~89 t, so I count ~89 t x 0.286 oz/t = ~25 oz. The reserve is better than the alternatives. A loan to E543-11 would add only ~54 t of broken ore and costs more travel. C512-01 and C538-07 are already covered by their own loaders. RS-C512-01 has the same grade as RS-C564-02 but a longer drift. RS-N574-03 is low grade and in a truck-limited mine. No development loader is touched. The estimate is approximate because the truck cycle mid-depth is assumed and the oz/t conversion uses grade only.
